headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: May 20, 2026**
article:
The Cleveland Guardians secured a pair of wins, including an 8-2 victory over the Detroit Tigers, where José Ramírez hit three home runs. The Tampa Bay Rays dominated the Baltimore Orioles 16-6, led by Junior Caminero's two hits, one home run, and four RBIs. The Miami Marlins routed the Atlanta Braves 12-0, with Javier Sanoja contributing a home run and four RBIs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Lance McCullers Jr. (Houston Astros) and James McCann (Arizona Diamondbacks), who have been placed on the injured list due to right shoulder inflammation and a strained right quad, respectively. Other players affected by injuries include Joe Mantiply (Toronto Blue Jays), Clay Holmes (New York Mets), Garrett Acton (Minnesota Twins), Ryan Jeffers (Minnesota Twins), Drake Baldwin (Atlanta Braves), and Jordan Beck (Colorado Rockies).

The Los Angeles Dodgers acquired Eric Lauer from the Toronto Blue Jays in a trade for cash. The Chicago White Sox received Junior Perez from the Athletics in exchange for Jackson Nove, while the Athletics traded Kyle Robinson to the Pittsburgh Pirates for Alika Williams. The Athletics also traded Eduarniel Núñez to the Baltimore Orioles for cash.

top_news.title: **Guardians Take Down Tigers 8-2**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured an 8-2 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Slade Cecconi earning the win. José Ramírez led the Guardians' offense, hitting 3 home runs, including a 8th homer on a fly ball to left field.

top_news.title: **Rays Rout Orioles 16-6**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays dominated the Baltimore Orioles, securing a 16-6 victory. Junior Caminero led the Orioles' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Reds Fall Short in Philly**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds dropped a 4-5 decision to the Philadelphia Phillies, marking their loss in the matchup. Bryson Stott led the Phillies' offense with a home run and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Marlins Rout Braves 12-0**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins dominated the Atlanta Braves, securing a 12-0 victory. Javier Sanoja led the Marlins' offense with a home run and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Braves Take Down Marlins 8-4**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves secured an 8-4 victory over the Miami Marlins, led by strong performances from multiple players. Mauricio Dubón, Matt Olson, and Michael Harris II were among the key contributors for the Braves.

top_news.title: **Guardians Edge Tigers in Thrilling 4-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a narrow win over the Detroit Tigers, with Parker Messick's strong performance on the mound contributing to the team's success. Impact hitters for the Tigers included Travis Bazzana, Riley Greene, and Spencer Torkelson, who all made notable contributions in the game.

top_news.title: **Astros RHP Lance McCullers Jr. Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Lance McCullers Jr. has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right shoulder inflammation, effective retroactive to May 16, 2026. The move aims to give the right-hander time to recover and return to the mound.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Acquire LHP Eric Lauer in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers have added left-handed pitcher Eric Lauer to their roster, acquired in a trade with the Toronto Blue Jays for cash.
